title: Menu Dismissal Reason
description: Union type describing why a context menu should close.
signature: export type Dismissal = { reason: 'escape' } | { reason: 'pointer'; insideMenu: boolean } | { reason: 'blur' } | { reason: 'scroll' } | { reason: 'resize' } | { reason: 'selected' }
semantics: Represents all events that can trigger menu closure.
